articles.title: NVS-03 navigation satellite awaits GSLV-Mk2 launch in mid-October 2026 as sources cite a 15-20 October window after NVS-02 orbit failure
articles.summary: India is set to launch NVS-03, a second-generation NavIC satellite, using a GSLV-Mk2 rocket from Sriharikota. This mission is crucial for bolstering India's indigenous regional navigation system (NavIC), enhancing its strategic capabilities for both civilian and defence applications. The launch signifies significant progress in India's space technology and self-reliance in critical navigation services.

articles.title: Satellite images show China building new class of submarine, India’s submarine plans compared
articles.summary: Satellite imagery reveals China is constructing a new nuclear-powered attack submarine at Bohai Shipyard, showcasing Beijing's latest design. This underscores China's rapid naval modernization and enhanced underwater warfare capabilities. Such developments hold significant strategic implications for Indo-Pacific security, influencing the maritime power balance and prompting close observation from nations like India.

articles.title: Fifteen men found guilty for roles in 2019 Sri Lanka bombings that killed more than 260
articles.summary: A Sri Lankan court has found 15 men guilty for their involvement in the devastating 2019 Easter Sunday bombings. These coordinated attacks, which targeted churches and hotels, tragically killed over 260 people and wounded around 500. The verdict marks a significant step towards justice for one of the nation's deadliest terror incidents, bringing closure to victims' families.

articles.title: Terrorism and Heroism
articles.summary: The article vehemently criticizes the romanticized portrayal of Thileepan, challenging those who depict him as an "innocent Tamil university student hero." It argues that such narratives stem from ignorance of his true identity and actions, implying a more complex and controversial historical background. The piece aims to correct public perception regarding this figure's legacy.

articles.title: James Gunn’s Lanterns Comments Suggest a Major Fan Theory Is True (& That’s Great News)
articles.summary: The article warns of spoilers for 'Lanterns' episode 6, which recently aired. It announces the series has only two episodes remaining, indicating its rapid approach towards conclusion. This update also suggests these final episodes might mark the end of the entire show, as no second season has been confirmed, providing a crucial update for the series' audience.

articles.title: From being fired at her job at 27 to building an $800 million luxury brand: The Tamara Mellon Story
articles.summary: Tamara Mellon's career journey highlights her transformation from being fired at 27 to establishing an $800 million luxury fashion brand. Her story details how she navigated a significant career crisis, leveraging resilience and entrepreneurial vision to build a successful empire in the global fashion industry, demonstrating remarkable business acumen and growth from the UK.
